subject: CPA Project Funding Recommendations
overview: The committee reviewed 11 project applications recommended by the Community Preservation Committee and voted to refer the funding requests to the regular City Council meeting with a favorable recommendation.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Overview
items.summary: The Community Preservation Committee (CPC) explained its review process, noting that 11 of 16 applications were prioritized for immediate funding while five remain under consideration.

items.title: Shiloh Baptist Church Restoration
items.summary: Favorably referred the request for $150,000 to restore the exterior and stained glass of the historic church building to improve energy efficiency and community utility.

items.title: Housing Families Rental Assistance
items.summary: Favorably referred $10,000 for Housing Families Incorporated to provide emergency rental assistance and pro bono legal services for homelessness prevention in Medford.

items.title: Carr Park Pickleball Courts
items.summary: Favorably referred $402,000 for the construction of four dedicated pickleball courts as part of the first phase of the Carr Park rehabilitation project.

items.title: Gillis Park Fitness and Picnic Area
items.summary: Favorably referred $96,864 for a new outdoor fitness area and picnic space as part of a larger accessibility renovation at Gillis Park.

items.title: COVID Memorial Grove Design
items.summary: Favorably referred $28,000 to fund design and community outreach services for a proposed memorial grove to honor those affected by the pandemic.

items.title: Duggar Park Backboard and Plaque
items.summary: Favorably referred $9,000 for a tennis and lacrosse bounce-back wall at Duggar Park, including a plaque to commemorate local tennis figure Clarence A. Rohn.

items.title: Isaac Hall Preservation Project
items.summary: Favorably referred $85,000 for the restoration of 53 windows and three metal doors at the Islamic Cultural Center of Medford.

items.title: Brooks Estate Access Drive Design
items.summary: Favorably referred $35,000 to finalize engineering and design work for the access drive and water infrastructure at the Brooks Estate.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Caretakers' Quarters Study
items.summary: Favorably referred $50,000 for a historic preservation study to scope out the renovation needs for the cemetery's wood-frame caretaker building.

items.title: McGlynn Universally Accessible Playground
items.summary: Favorably referred $500,000 for the construction of a new accessible playground, with the CPC noting that an additional $400,000 would likely be requested in a future cycle to complete the project.

items.title: Hickey Park Softball Dugouts
items.summary: Favorably referred $90,000 for the installation of dugout shelters to provide shade and rain protection for Medford Youth Softball participants.
